summary.text: Jim White is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 30 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
White, listed by Ballotpedia as James White, has represented District 30 since 2022 and is a U.S. Navy veteran and gunsmith.

paragraphs.text: Jim White served in the U.S. Navy and the U.S. Navy Reserves, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as gunsmith; Ballotpedia lists him as James White.
He took office in District 30 in 2022, succeeding Rebecca Millett, and served on the Transportation Committee in 2023-2024.
John Contreni Jr. is the Democratic candidate against him in the 2026 general election.
